status: literature-only; both public arXiv v1 full texts read; no fitting or independent reproduction
scope: Current-literature cross-check of interaction versus dynamical-DE degeneracy and Q=Gamma rho_x with DESI DR2, compared to the reduced Dovekie-only SN profile.

papers.title: Reassessing Evidence for Dark-Sector Interactions with Dynamical Dark Energy and DESI DR2

source.access_level: Public arXiv v1 full text; downloaded locally and read

locators.CPL_results: Printed p. 5, Table 1; discussion through pp. 6-7

model.transfer_four_vector: Q^nu = Q u_c^nu; momentum transfer vanishes in the CDM rest frame
model.sign: beta > 0 transfers energy from CDM to DE; beta < 0 transfers DE to CDM
model.perturbations: Interacting generalized PPF, stable through w=-1 crossing

datasets: Planck high-multipole Plik-lite TT restricted to ell <= 1000 and TE/EE to ell <= 600
ACT DR6 plus Planck CMB lensing
papers.sn_treatment: Identifies DES-Dovekie as the recalibrated DES five-year SN compilation with photometric cross-calibration, updated light-curve training and low-z SNe; paper does not specify its SN intercept or nuisance/covariance treatment.

inference.comparison: MAP delta-chi-square and AIC relative to LCDM; no Bayes evidence reported

limits: No Bayes factor reported; comparison uses MAP likelihood and AIC.
Growth spectra use representative parameter sets rather than posterior propagation.
Conclusions depend on Q proportional to H rho_de and selected w(z) trajectories.
SN nuisance and covariance treatment is not described in detail.

papers.title: Do DESI-DR2 BAO data imply a coupling of dark matter and dark energy?
papers.publication_status: Accepted for Physical Review D; DOI 10.1103/6kdf-vzq4

source.access_level: Public arXiv v1 full text; downloaded locally and read

locators.datasets_priors_inference: Printed pp. 8-11, Table I on p. 10

model.sign: Gamma > 0 transfers energy from CDM to DE; Gamma < 0 transfers DE to CDM
model.background_assumptions: Baryons, radiation, and neutrinos separately conserved; sum m_nu=0.06 eV and N_eff=3.044 fixed.
model.perturbations: Synchronous gauge; zero anisotropic stress; no momentum transfer in DM frame; c_s^2=1 in inference for w_x != -1; IVS has no DE perturbation contribution.

datasets.bao: DESI DR2 BGS, ELG, LRG, QSO, and Ly-alpha auto/cross measurements
supernova_runs: DES-Dovekie: DES five-year SN reanalysis; sample count not specified in this article

papers.sn_treatment: Names DES-Dovekie as the DES five-year reanalysis but does not detail SN intercept, covariance, or calibration nuisance handling.

inference.software: Modified CAMB, Cobaya MCMC, Gelman-Rubin convergence check, GetDist
inference.bayesian_evidence: MCEvidence; ln B_iLambda = ln Z_interacting - ln Z_LCDM; negative values favor LCDM
inference.evidence_scale: Paper treats absolute ln B of 2.5-5 as moderate and 5-10 as strong

cmb_desi_des_dovekie_ivs.interpretation: Posterior leans to a negative coupling at 68%, but Bayes evidence moderately favors LCDM.

cmb_desi_des_dovekie_phantom.interpretation: Posterior interaction indication reported; strong Bayes evidence favors LCDM.

cmb_desi_des_dovekie_quintessence.interpretation: No interaction detection; strong Bayes evidence favors LCDM.

limits: Constant-w_x branches; does not test CPL dynamical w(z).
The compared models use sign-restricted priors for phantom and quintessence branches.
Listed likelihoods do not include low-redshift RSD or weak-lensing data.
Dovekie SN nuisance and covariance treatment is not specified in detail.
Bayesian evidence depends on the stated parameter priors.

current_profile_comparison.local_model: Reduced flat late-time IVS with Q=Gamma rho_vac, g=Gamma/H0, full 1820-row Dovekie STAT+SYS covariance, and one profiled unbounded common magnitude intercept.
interpretation_limits: Exploratory finite-domain profile, not a posterior, evidence, p-value, sigma, or Wilks interval.
No CMB or BAO likelihood; no radiation, perturbations, or early-time viability test.
No H0 or dimensional Gamma inference; the common SN intercept absorbs the H0 gauge.
current_profile_comparison.comparison: The local vacuum model has the same Q=Gamma rho_x law and sign convention as the IVS branch in 2609.05660, but uses a reduced SN-only likelihood rather than Planck+DESI+SN full cosmology. 2609.03062 instead uses Q=beta H rho_de and CPL freedom. The differing coupling estimates and model preferences are not contradictory because both the likelihood and model assumptions differ.

current_verdict: The literature supports model- and dataset-dependent interaction indications. The local Dovekie-only result is a shallow exploratory shape preference and is not literature-confirmed evidence; neither paper is a like-for-like validation.
next_test_implication: First reproduce the closest published case: a full Planck 2018 + DESI DR2 + DES-Dovekie IVS inference with Q=Gamma rho_x, the paper's Gamma/H0 prior [-3,3], and matched Dovekie likelihood, reporting posterior constraints and ln Bayes evidence. This tests how the reduced SN-only optimum moves when CMB and BAO are added.
